## CSV / JSON  ·  Telemetry  ·  SNMP  ·  APIs  ·  Logs

### Collectors → Validate → Normalize → Enrich → **Kafka** → TimescaleDB / ML / Alerts / RCA → **Grafana & AIOps Expert**

Every record carries `schema_version`, `message_id`, `source_type`, `source_system`, `observed_at`, `site_id`, `asset_id`, `is_simulated`, labels and payload. Invalid inputs are quarantined and routed to `ingestion.errors`.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM ingestion.source_events WHERE status='published' AND $__timeFilter(received_at)
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM ingestion.source_events WHERE status='rejected' AND $__timeFilter(received_at)
SELECT count(DISTINCT source_system) AS value FROM ingestion.source_events WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at)
SELECT date_trunc('minute',received_at) AS time,source_type AS metric,count(*) AS value FROM ingestion.source_events WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND status='published' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT topic AS "Topic",count(*) AS "Events" FROM ingestion.source_events WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY topic ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT source_type AS "Source Type",source_system AS "Source System",received AS "Received",published AS "Published",rejected AS "Rejected",last_received_at AS "Last Received",last_published_at AS "Last Published",coalesce(latest_error,'') AS "Latest Error" FROM ingestion.source_health ORDER BY last_received_at DESC

SELECT received_at AS "Received",source_type AS "Source",source_system AS "Source System",topic AS "Kafka Topic",event_type AS "Event Type",coalesce(site_id,'') AS "Site",coalesce(asset_id,'') AS "Asset",CASE WHEN is_simulated THEN 'Simulated' ELSE 'Live' END AS "Data Type",status AS "Status" FROM ingestion.source_events WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT run_key AS "Simulation",status AS "Status",started_at AS "Started",ends_at AS "Ends",interval_seconds/60 AS "Interval Minutes",batch_count AS "Batches",event_count AS "Published Events",error_count AS "Errors",last_emitted_at AS "Last Batch",greatest(0,round(extract(epoch FROM (ends_at-now()))/3600,1)) AS "Hours Remaining" FROM ingestion.simulator_runs ORDER BY started_at DESC
